newsitem.title: INDIA: India's CARE downgrades MDL to CARE BB+(FD).
newsitem.headline: India's CARE downgrades MDL to CARE BB+(FD).

text.p: India's Credit Analysis & Research Ltd (CARE) said on Wednesday that it had downgraded the rating of the fixed deposit programme of Modern Denim Limited (MDL) upto an amount of 250 million rupees from CARE A-(FD) Sinle A minus to CARE BB+(FD).

It said in a statement that such instruments are considered to be speculative, with inadequate protection for interest and principal payments. The downgradations take into account the time over-run and difficulties in raising funds for capital expenditure programmes and the continuing liquidity problems in the group.
